definitions.gloss: to be transparent; to be crystal clear
definitions.explanation: To be so clear that one can see through it. Used for water, air, skin, and also for voices that are pure and clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{透|す}き{通|とお}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{透|す}き{通|とお}るような⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She has a clear, pure voice.

examples.japanese: {透|す}き{通|とお}った⟦{青空|あおぞら}→青空：10084_aozora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{稜線|りょうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦くっきり→くっきり：19407_kukkiri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Under the perfectly clear blue sky, the mountain ridgeline was sharply visible.

notes:
{透|す}き{通|とお}る is an intransitive godan verb. The adjective form {透|す}き{通|とお}った is very common as a modifier.

ASPECT (ている):
{透|す}き{通|とお}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes a state of being transparent/clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {透|す}き{通|とお}った⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (crystal clear water)
- {透|す}き{通|とお}るような⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (a clear, pure voice)
- {透|す}き{通|とお}った⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (translucent skin)
- {透|す}き{通|とお}った⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧ (crisp, clear air)

Often used in poetic or admiring descriptions. When applied to voices, it suggests a pure, high, and beautiful quality. When applied to skin, it suggests a fair, porcelain-like complexion.
